entities.summary: The Musée du Général Leclerc de Hauteclocque et de la Libération de Paris – Musée Jean Moulin was a museum located in the 15th arrondissement of Paris at 23, Allée de la 2e DB, Jardin Atlantique, Paris, France. It was open daily except Mondays; as of 2022 admission is free of charge.
